newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales to total $908 mln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales to total $908 mln for Wednesday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for Wednesday are expected to total $908 million in 27 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $57 million in 12 issues. The largest is a $15 million University of Louisville, Ky., revenue bond issue at 1100 EST.
Negotiated sales total $851 million in 15 offerings. The largest is a $224 million Indiana Health deal through Smith Barney.
An additional 10 issues totaling $265 million on Reuters possible negotiated calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may priced the deals Wednesday depending on market conditions.
